async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Members to add
    members_to_add = ['JonasVautherin', 'dilipchandima', 'dawiss1337', 'bmyun', 'DCMJY']
    
    for member in members_to_add:
        # Locate the open dialog 'Invite members'
        dialog = page.get_by_role('dialog', name='Invite members', exact=False)
        # Fill the textbox in the dialog with the member username
        # The textbox is not explicitly in the tree, but it's part of the dialog for input
        textbox = dialog.get_by_role('textbox')
        await textbox.fill(member)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)  # Wait for any suggestions to appear
        # The combobox is already set to 'Developer', so no action needed
        # Click the 'Invite' button to add the member
        invite_button = dialog.get_by_role('button', name='Invite', exact=False)
        await invite_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the member to be added
    
    # After adding all members, close the dialog
    close_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Close', exact=False)
    if await close_button.count() > 0:
        await close_button.first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
